cli.intro: ocae - OpenCAE truss/beam linear-static and modal solver (2D/3D)
usage: ocae solve <file> [--out report.json] [--analysis static|modal] [--modes N] [--element truss|beam] [--dimension 2|3]
cli.exit: Exit codes: 0 success, 1 input/validation error, 2 capability not implemented

message.supportAdded: support `{node}` added (dx={dx}, dy={dy}, dz={dz}, rz={rz}, revision {revision})

error.unknownSubcommand: `{group}` has no subcommand `{action}`; only `{expected}` is supported
error.missingSubcommand: `{group}` needs a subcommand; only `{expected}` is supported
error.invalidDimension: unknown dimension `{value}`; only 2 or 3 is supported
error.unknownFormat: unknown export format `{format}`; only csv, vtk or md is supported
error.unknownAnalysis: unknown analysis `{value}`; only static or modal is supported
error.unknownElement: unknown element type `{value}`; only truss or beam is supported
error.invalidModes: `--modes` value `{value}` is not a positive integer
error.dimensionMismatch: `--dimension {requested}` does not match document dimension {dimension}; change the document or drop the option
error.noFreedom: specify at least one of `--dx`, `--dy`, `--dz` or `--rz`, otherwise the support constrains nothing
